title: ICAI Releases 10th Edition (Revised 2026) Guidance Note on Transfer Pricing Reporting
content:
# ICAI Releases 10th Edition (Revised 2026) Guidance Note on Transfer Pricing Reporting

Ek important update hai for all Chartered Accountants! The Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI) ne "Guidance Note on Report under Section 92E of the Income-tax Act, 1961 (Transfer Pricing)" ka 10th Edition (Revised 2026) release kar diya hai. This is a crucial professional reference for transfer pricing compliance and reporting in Form No. 3CEB.

Here's what you need to know:

*   **What's New:** This revised Guidance Note incorporates significant developments, jaise ki relevant legislative amendments, notifications, circulars, aur judicial pronouncements. It fully updates the professional guidance to align with the latest changes applicable under the Income-tax Act, 1961.
*   **Why it's Important:** Yeh update CAs ke liye bahut zaroori hai because it addresses the statutory scope aur professional responsibilities related to transfer pricing, jisme statutory provisions, rules, aur reporting requirements ki thorough understanding lagti hai.
*   **Availability:** Yeh publication ICAI Publication Portal par available hai.
